newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen down for third session running.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen down for third session running.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to fall for the third session running as investors continued to take profits after the recent six-session, 14.5-percent surge.
Analysts said some players could be encouraged to buy after the Dow's Monday rebound and that the market should soon stabilise after the recent sharp price swings.
Analysts also said some stocks should be affected by July earnings data, most published on Monday.
